_doc: Weekly account-facts refresh (run_account_facts_refresh.sh, launchd com.dallasandrews.gtm.accountfacts, Sunday 06:00, plist NOT loaded until Dallas says so). Selects universe domains with no fact or a fact older than max_age_days, fans out the researcher prompt in automation/prompts/account_facts_researcher.txt, writes JSON to automation/inbox/account_facts/<date>/, then account_facts_merge.py validates and merges. merge=false means DRY RUN: the diff is logged, data/account_facts.json is not written.
